description: Knobs and control voltage for four of Rack's own appearance settings: cable opacity, cable tension, room brightness and light bloom

params.text: Sets how far the cable opacity input moves the setting, 0% to 100%; it comes up at 0%, so a patched cable does nothing until this is turned up
Sets how far the cable tension input moves the setting, 0% to 100%; it comes up at 0%, so a patched cable does nothing until this is turned up
Sets how far the room brightness input moves the setting, 0% to 100%; it comes up at 0%, so a patched cable does nothing until this is turned up
Sets how far the light bloom input moves the setting, 0% to 100%; it comes up at 0%, so a patched cable does nothing until this is turned up

inputs.text: Moves the cable opacity away from the knob setting, 10% per volt at a full amount, scaled by the small knob beside it and held between 0% and 100%
Moves the cable tension away from the knob setting, 10% per volt at a full amount, scaled by the small knob beside it and held between 0% and 100%
Moves the room brightness away from the knob setting, 10% per volt at a full amount, scaled by the small knob beside it and held between 0% and 100%
Moves the light bloom away from the knob setting, 10% per volt at a full amount, scaled by the small knob beside it and held between 0% and 100%

notes: this module writes Rack's own settings, so the change outlives the patch; the four values it found when it started are put back when it is removed
only one Rui works at a time; a second one added to the patch is drawn greyed out with no controls on it at all
the small round button at the top hides and shows all cables at once, and F6 with the pointer over the module does the same; it is not a parameter, so no click on it reaches this help
the triangle button at the bottom, and F2 with the pointer over the module, stops the module writing the settings; no click on it reaches this help
the settings are read from the knobs about once every 64 samples rather than every sample, so a fast signal on the inputs is sampled coarsely
menu: Reset — puts the four large knobs back to Rack's default settings and the four amounts to zero
Fluff — shows or hides the coloured shapes drawn behind the controls
